nodes.content: Moved emoji-drawer outside of view-connected in popup.html to ensure it's visible in both connected and disconnected states. Updated popup.js to show the Recent tab in avatar mode and ensure avatar selections are recorded in recents. Resolved h5i path mangling in settings.json by switching to forward slashes.
Reverting 7b126ff UI strip to restore Duet visual branding, gradients, logo ring, and avatar animations. Added Screenshot*.png to .gitignore.
